name: Inaka de Shiyou! Tottori Hen -Boku to Imouto-tachi no Natsuyasumi-
original_name: 田舎でシよう! 鳥取編 －ボクと妹たちの夏休み－
source:
"Onii-chan is coming back---"

The big brother that left home years ago comes back into his hometown for the summer vacation.

At the time they had to part with their big brother, his young sisters cried, since they couldn't meet him anymore.
After that they grew up themself.
They aren't just always crying children anymore.

"We'll surely meet again"

Those two Imoutos always looked forward to meet him again.

One of them has faint feelings in her heart...

One of them is interested in sex...


[Freely translated from the producer's story-page]
translation:
“欧尼酱要回来了——”

多年前离家出走的哥哥回到家乡过暑假。

当他们不得不与哥哥分开时，他的妹妹们哭了，因为她们再也见不到他了。
之后他们自己也长大了。
他们不再只是总是哭泣的孩子了。

“我们一定会再见面的”

那两个伊莫托总是期待着再次见到他。

其中一人心里隐隐有种感觉……

其中一个对性感兴趣……
